items.textToSpeech: Iron contributes to: normal cognitive function, normal energy-yielding metabolism, normal formation of red blood cells and haemoglobin, normal oxygen transport in the body, normal function of the immune system, the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Iron has a role in the process of cell division, and contributes to normal cognitive development of children.

The European Commission has authorised these claims for products which contain at least 2.1 milligrams of iron per 100 grams, per 100 millilitres or per package, if the package contains only a single portion. Is there anything else I can help you with?
